title: Sweep LR warmdown length (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8 (longer, gentler LR cooldown starting at progress=0.2 instead of 0.5), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005098, worse than baseline 1.002279 (a regression of ~0.28%). A longer warmdown (more time spent at reduced LR) hurt rather than helped at this fixed 5-min budget -- the model apparently benefits more from a longer flat-LR exploration phase than from a longer cooldown. This is the third consecutive round where a single-hyperparameter perturbation off the DEPTH=10 baseline failed to improve on it (after depth=12 and MATRIX_LR=0.05), suggesting the current baseline sits in a fairly sharp/narrow optimum for these particular axes. Future rounds should either try the opposite direction (WARMDOWN_RATIO < 0.5, e.g. 0.3) or move to an entirely different axis (e.g. WEIGHT_DECAY, EMBEDDING_LR, or WINDOW_PATTERN) rather than another isolated schedule-shape lengthening.
